diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts correctly identified the standard windows (Tuesday 0800-1200 for vehicle recovery and Wednesday 1300-1600 for preventive maintenance) using only shared facts S1-S4, without needing the hidden information in PF1 or PF2. The model is defaulting to these standard windows based on the provided context, making the specific shifts caused by PF1 and PF2 impossible to detect through current content checks.
